name: Skin Disease diagnosis using CvT-RAG
creator: Janhavi Belnekar
description: An AI powered skin disease diagnosis assistant that combines computer vision, image retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to analyze skin lesions images and provide an interpretable clinical style report.

name: EcoCompiler
creator: Shaymaa Mourchid
description: A developer tool that cleans up HTML code, motivated by optimizing web performance and reducing carbon emissions.

name: Obstacle avoiding car
creator: Aysha
description: An obstacle avoiding car which can detect obstacles through sensor and avoid them.
stack: The project uses C/C++ programming in the Arduino IDE to control the robot. The main hardware and technologies include the Arduino microcontroller, HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, servo motor, four DC geared motors, Adafruit Motor Shield (AFMotor library), NewPing library for ultrasonic distance measurement, and the Servo library for controlling the servo motor. A rechargeable 18650 battery pack supplies power to the system.

name: Hydromind-X
creator: Anbumathi chezhian
description: HydroMind-X is a smart water intelligence and continuous-auditing platform for sustainable data centers. It fuses live IoT sensor readings — temperature, humidity, water level, water flow and reservoir status — with weather forecasts to compute a single, easy-to-read Water Availability Index (WAI) from 0 to 100. Adjust the sliders above to simulate any environmental scenario and watch the index and the AI recommendations update instantly. As water becomes scarce, HydroMind-X automatically selects a more conservative cooling strategy, prioritizes critical workloads such as hospitals and emergency services, delays flexible tasks like model training, and maximizes recycled water use — then captures the whole decision as a downloadable audit report.
stack: Technology stack Frontend React Create React App Tailwind CSS Recharts and UI libraries Backend Python FastAPI MongoDB via Motor Pydantic

name: KEEPIT
creator: Amirah
description: KEEPIT is a personal ownership assistant that helps people organize purchase records, save receipts, and track return deadlines and warranties so they never lose track of the things they own.

name: HireSense AI – AI-Powered Interview Preparation Platform
creator: HireSense AI
description: HireSense AI is an AI-powered interview preparation platform that helps job seekers improve their interview performance through real-time analysis of speaking pace, pauses, volume, head movement, and on-screen positioning. It combines these signals with AI-powered transcript evaluation to deliver personalized feedback, actionable improvement suggestions, and stronger versions of interview answers.
stack: TypeScript, React 19, TanStack Start, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Web Audio API, MediaRecorder API, MediaPipe Tasks Vision (FaceLandmarker), Lovable Cloud, Supabase Edge Functions, Deno, Lovable AI Gateway, and Google Gemini 2.5 Flash.

name: Lingo
creator: diyeah
description: So you know how they say u only learn a language by speaking it out to a native person and there are so many apps for it. But what about sign language ? How do u know u r singing correctly? Hence Lingo was made , it teaches you sign language while ensuring u perform it correctly
stack: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, GoRouter, Hive, Google ML Kit (hand landmark detection), Lottie, and flutter_animate. We used Flutter's Clean Architecture to build a mobile ASL (American Sign Language) learning app.

name: VelvetTrace — Digital Footprint & Privacy Lab
creator: Genesis Naomí Luco Contreras
description: VelvetTrace is a cute, privacy-focused web application that helps users visualize and better understand their digital footprint. It transforms voluntarily provided information about online accounts and privacy habits into an interactive map that highlights potential exposure patterns and provides personalized cybersecurity recommendations.
stack: Python, FastAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, D3.js, NetworkX, SQLite, Figma, Visual Studio Code, Git, and GitHub. Python and FastAPI are used for the backend and privacy-risk analysis, while NetworkX models relationships between digital accounts and online behaviors as a graph. D3.js is used to create the interactive digital-footprint visualization, SQLite supports local data management, and HTML, CSS, and JavaScript build the web interface. Figma is used to design VelvetTrace’s minimalist pastel-pink visual identity, logo, interface components, and prototypes.

name: CodeLearner
creator: Ruvaa
description: CodeLearner is an AI-powered VS Code extension that helps programming beginners understand code, troubleshoot errors, generate explanatory comments, and explore practical examples through plain-English explanations and visual flowcharts. Built from my own experience transitioning from Food Science to Computer Science, it aims to make learning to code less intimidating by helping beginners understand not just what their code does, but how and why it works.
stack: * TypeScript * Visual Studio Code Extension API * Large Language Models (LLMs) * Serverless proxy architecture * Git and GitHub * Visual Studio Code Marketplace * Open VSX
